show.description: God of Teen Patti is a high-stakes thriller about deception, destiny, and the rise of a legend. Babban, a humble waiter with a hidden genius for cards, secretly holds the power to outwit the city’s most ruthless gamblers. As lies, greed, and betrayal swirl around him, the question remains—will he reveal himself as the true God of Teen Patti or stay hidden in the shadows?
